name: Limitless Nexus
description: Nexus build repository for Limitless providers. Active playable providers follow the canonical root-level NAMING_STANDARDS.md quality/audio/subtitle/mirror scheme; unknown stream classes are labeled [UNK] instead of guessed.

scrapers.name: Re:ANIME
scrapers.description: Anime provider with season-aware TMDB-to-AniList matching for TV seasons above Season 1, shared anime identity fallbacks, Season 0 specials handling, and evidence-based Nexus quality/audio/subtitle labels. Later seasons fail closed instead of silently falling back to Season 1.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus

scrapers.name: WCO
scrapers.description: WCO production provider with mirror coverage, strict title/episode ownership, anime identity support, specials handling, Power Rangers mapping, and evidence-based Nexus quality/audio/subtitle labels.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus WCO production merge

scrapers.name: AsiaFlix Test
scrapers.description: AsiaFlix v0.4.3 StreamHG targeted diagnostic. Captures the jah AJAX helper and every player_start call site to identify the exact player request endpoint and parameters.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus port based directly on verified-working Yuzono AsiaFlix v32

scrapers.name: Tubi
scrapers.description: Tubi playback provider with current anonymous auth, nested episode mapping, anime identity support, Power Rangers franchise-title mapping, compact diagnostics, and evidence-based Nexus stream labels.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus Tubi provider

scrapers.name: NetMirror
scrapers.description: Fast NetMirror provider using verified Net27/Aoneroom subject routing. Returns separately verified English and original audio encodes under the canonical naming tags, keeps only the two highest available qualities per audio lane, uses TMDB original language only as a fallback when direct audio evidence is unavailable, preserves selectable captions, and fails closed on subject/episode mismatch.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus; fast subject routing informed by Net27/Aoneroom topology investigation

scrapers.name: Vidlink
scrapers.description: Verified standalone Nexus-owned Vidlink provider using the general Nexus audio/subtitle decision tree. Caption tracks from the Vidlink payload are exposed to Nuvio; English-original content can fall back to [DUB], while non-English streams without subtitle/audio evidence remain [UNK].
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus; control behavior reference: Eclipsia Haylox/Vidlink

scrapers.name: KissKH
scrapers.description: Standalone Nexus-owned KissKH provider with strict title ownership, sequential domain/media fallbacks, EncDec token/subtitle handling, adaptive HLS expansion, no-source diagnostics, and Nexus naming-standard tags. Current Japanese first-party KissKH streams are manually verified [HSUB] when no selectable subtitle tracks exist.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus; flow cross-checked against maintained KissKH references
